title: Inspect the localization exports
description: You follow stored measurements, estimates, and selected heatmaps into artifacts.

steps.description: You create artifacts and save kf_localization_run.npz. Named entries include maze data, the sampling interval, true trajectory, measurements, estimates, and covariances.
You define save_heat to draw an existing heatmap, save its figure, and close it. The helper places each image under artifacts.

steps.question: Which heatmaps does this block export?
steps.answer: It exports the first, middle, and last maps. The middle index uses integer division of the heatmap count by two.

steps.description: You list the artifact directory after saving. The recording includes the NPZ archive and belief_t0.png, belief_t15.png, and belief_tT.png.
